summary: Busy Whitmore Street kerb with apartments 9-11 m away and bus zones.
reasons: Bus zones and no stopping signs

best_section.where: West kerb north of the apartment blocks, near the carport

drivers.seclusion: Apartment blocks and carports line the west side; apartments mapped 9 m and 11 m from kerb.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed multi-lane road, a few cars park on the kerb but signs show no stopping and bus zones.
drivers.traffic: Arterial-style road with a fire station and shops nearby; constant traffic.
drivers.convention: Few parked cars; no sign of overnight stays.
